package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/ast"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/core"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/parser"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/tspath"
	cfg "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/ecmascript/control_flow_graph"
	"os"
	sourcepath "path"
	"strings"
)

type fact struct {
	Present bool   `json:"present"`
	Kind    int    `json:"kind"`
	Text    string `json:"text"`
	Inner   []fact `json:"inner"`
}

func project(node *ast.Node) fact {
	f := fact{Inner: []fact{}}
	if node == nil {
		return f
	}
	f.Present = true
	f.Kind = int(node.Kind)
	switch node.Kind {
	case ast.KindParenthesizedExpression:
		f.Inner = append(f.Inner, project(node.AsParenthesizedExpression().Expression))
	case ast.KindNumericLiteral:
		f.Text = node.AsNumericLiteral().Text
	case ast.KindBigIntLiteral:
		f.Text = node.AsBigIntLiteral().Text
	case ast.KindStringLiteral:
		f.Text = node.AsStringLiteral().Text
	}
	return f
}
func main() {
	if os.Args[1] == "--nil" {
		cfg.AdamicIsAlwaysTruthyTest(nil)
		return
	}
	if os.Args[1] == "--kinds" {
		fmt.Printf("%d %d %d %d %d %d\n", ast.KindParenthesizedExpression, ast.KindTrueKeyword, ast.KindRegularExpressionLiteral, ast.KindNumericLiteral, ast.KindBigIntLiteral, ast.KindStringLiteral)
		return
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[2])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var inputs []struct{ File, Source, Rule string }
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &inputs); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	facts := []fact{}
	want := os.Args[1] == "--want"

	for _, row := range inputs {
		kind := core.ScriptKindTS
		if strings.HasSuffix(row.File, ".tsx") {
			kind = core.ScriptKindTSX
		} else if strings.HasSuffix(row.File, ".jsx") {
			kind = core.ScriptKindJSX
		} else if strings.HasSuffix(row.File, ".js") {
			kind = core.ScriptKindJS
		}
		fileName := sourcepath.Clean("/corpus/" + row.File)
		source := parser.ParseSourceFile(ast.SourceFileParseOptions{FileName: fileName, Path: tspath.Path(fileName)}, row.Source, kind)
		var visit func(*ast.Node)
		visit = func(node *ast.Node) {
			if want {
				fmt.Println(cfg.AdamicIsAlwaysTruthyTest(node))
			} else {
				facts = append(facts, project(node))
			}
			node.ForEachChild(func(child *ast.Node) bool { visit(child); return false })
		}
		visit(source.AsNode())
	}
	if !want {
		if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(facts); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
}
